# LLMs.txt - Edraak Systems
# Purpose: Provide structured, AI-readable information about the company, products, and capabilities

[COMPANY]
Name: Edraak Systems
Website: https://edraaksystems.com
Type: Organization
Industry: Textile Technology, AI, Computer Vision
Description: Edraak Systems is a global provider of AI-powered fabric quality control and traceability solutions. The company develops advanced vision inspection systems using high-resolution line-scan cameras to detect, analyze, and report textile defects such as holes, stains, and weave inconsistencies at high production speeds.

Core Capabilities:
- AI-based Fabric Inspection
- Computer Vision Systems
- Real-time Defect Detection
- Production Traceability
- Process Optimization

[PLATFORM]
Name: Edraak Vision System (EVS)
Description: AI-powered vision platform designed for textile manufacturers and system integrators. Enables defect detection, workflow automation, and scalable inspection across production lines.

Workflow:
Integrate → Customize → Optimize → Scale
